Captured live on radendur (the patched build, one start), each family's own dumper writing after
its body raised. A count watch on the blitter's strobe 0x70001e (length 2), a capture of the frame
counter 0x2031fc triggered on its low word 0x2031fe, the manifest's palette log `ramdac` and a
`changed` film on 0x70001e were armed, the machine ran two frames, and a fault was planted in each
from the harness, never from the server (`plant_fault` in tests/live/live_matrix.py): the count
watch's value table and the log's pen table index through a metatable that raises, the capture's
pending rows refuse an assignment, and the film's previous value raises when read. Four frames
later the reads (`watch_list`, `palette_log`, `gfx_film`) wrote the dumps as of that stop, copied
as they were.

tally-raised.txt      the count watch: `total` counts every write and the value table is empty,
                      `errors=` the writes since the fault, the first message on its `e` line.
capture-raised.txt    the capture: the rows from before the fault only, one error per trigger
                      write since.
ramdac-raised.txt     the palette log: no pen written, one error per synced data write.
film-raised.txt       the film: one error per strobe write its tap took since the fault.

dump-failed.errorlog.txt
                      the line the guard logs for a dumper that raised, copied from `error.log`
                      as the live matrix's C.7 cell read it: a count watch on 0x70001e (length 2)
                      on radendur, its item's `endianness` made to raise when the dumper
                      formats it, after the `.tmp` is open (`DUMPER_FAULT` in
                      tests/live/live_matrix.py). Logged once over two stops. The unit tests put
                      their own tap's id in place of `70001e_2`; the rest of the line is as MAME
                      wrote it.
